description.narrative: IFC is considering an equity investment of up to US$4 million in EmergingTech Ventures Fund II (Emtech II of the Fund), a Moroccan domiciled early-stage VC fund targeting a first closing at US$40 million (MAD 400 million). The Fund is managed by EmergingTech Ventures SA (Emtech or the Fund Manager).

The Fund will increase access to equity and operational value added for tech startups in Morocco and Tunisia. This will help scale innovative digital businesses and provide critical services and products across sectors. Via Fund II, Emtech will continue its value creation strategy from Fund I, while seeking a limited expansion beyond Morocco. Besides, the venture capital fund ecosystem in North Africa has very few good quality local fund managers that are concentrated in a handful of key markets, with most fund managers only one-to-two funds old. Developing locally based fund managers, backed by institutional capital, with the ability to support Pre-Series A and Series A activity will be critical to deepening the VC ecosystem in the region and providing a ramp for startups to obtain financing as they scale.
